counting_policy: One literal retrospective label per independently recorded APK build, ordered by artifact upload time; 133 successful build artifacts, 132 distinct APK byte hashes. The byte-identical pair comes from separate successful optimised build jobs, not two uploads in one job. Development / QA builds are not public releases; original binaries and embedded versions are unchanged.
history_limitations: All 133 retained APK artifact archives and binary manifests were inspected; this cannot recover deleted artifacts or unrecorded builds.
The earliest retained APK is the first verifiable Supernova-lineage build, not independently proven to be the first APK ever created.
Retrospective labels are literal counters, distinct from historical embedded versions. Source checkpoint notes describe verified code changes; they are not physical-device acceptance claims.

notes: Shared three-panel Settings and Network & Files, plus one compact Home and TV file browser with complete breadcrumbs and persisted controls.
Staged recursive library selection and exclusions, atomic Apply & Scan, and five-category Library Health that retains unavailable records and viewing progress.
Home row/artwork/focus refinements, symmetric Movies/TV controls, local indexed Search, compact Details/Cast/Crew and one five-step custom Library Page.
Four-action playback HUD, immediate Restart, five-second Up Next, real viewed-coverage threshold and persisted manual versions with native technical badges.
Safe segment policies with verified movie outro/post-credit boundaries; existing subtitle/audio controls and scan engine retained.
Nonsecret format 1.0 backup instructions, staged validation/rollback and reauthentication; bounded redacted diagnostics and coloured My Providers.
Development QA candidate: physical Shield playback/navigation/storage and signed 0.134 upgrade validation remain required before final release.
Restores the approved Home hero-card carousel and More Info action from the verified corrective Preview implementation.
Keeps focused row artwork and its highlighted boundary together inside the rounded card body.
Always selects the approved Supernova interface in Foundation, including restored preferences.
Preserves permanent identity, protected signing, approved branding and loading indicators, About/licences and source-verified media libraries.
history.evidence: Previously recorded signed APK signature, package, CRC and source verification. Archive digest is recorded Actions metadata; no fresh archive download claimed.

notes: Permanent Supernova identity and dedicated release signing.

Media libraries rebuilt from verified source with the existing codecs and features.
Installed successfully on NVIDIA Shield; physical testing revealed missing Home carousel and artwork focus containment, addressed in the next correction.
